Name: Water Jellies from machines
Author: bananasalmon
Description:
[size=3][b]Introduction[/b][/size]
Do you also have too many fish in the sea (or river or cave)? So water jellies are now tooo rare? With this mod you can produce sea jelly, river jelly and cave jelly from artisan machines, so you can start getting that fish smoker!

[size=3][b]Options and compatibility[/b][/size]
Can be installed anytime and will work immediately on the first in-game day!

What you can produce:
[list]
[*]seaweed into sea jelly[/*]
[*]green algae into river jelly[/*]
[*]white algae into cave jelly[/*]
[/list]What you can change:
[list]
[*]how many do you need for production: default is 20[/*]
[*]what machine you need[/*]
[/list]Machines to choose from:
[list]
[*]preserves jar (default)[/*]
[*]mayonnaise machine[/*]
[*]oil maker[/*]
[*]slime egg-press[/*]
[*]none (mod is de-activated)[/*]
[/list]
All machines take their respective 'default' time to process, for example the preserves jar takes 4000 minutes, while the mayonnaise machine takes 180 minutes.
This mod has been tested and proven compatible with Cornucopia Artisan Machines. To be more precise, with that mod you can process any fish in preserves jars and oil makers. However since seaweed, green algae and white algae are not fish, Cornucopia has no machine rules for these items, and no extra code was needed.
But, in case you are also using a mod that edits item categories, I have built in extra secure compatibility for Cornucopia. So you should be able to choose any machine you like.

[size=3][b]Roadmap[/b][/size]
If you have suggestions how to improve this mod or if you need more compatibilities, let me know! Just keep it to QoL improvements and not too unrealistic. :-)

[size=3][b]Credits[/b][/size]
Nothing, idea by me. I have not found anything comparable to exist yet, but since they are simple machines rules they are not 'my property'. Anyone can have the same idea as me of course.
